title: Laashe Qasim Pe Ye
body:
laashe qasim pe ye kehte thay shehenshahe zaman
kaise le jaaun mai mayyat teri farzande hassan
tukde tukde hai badan
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj qaime mein teri maa ko bada hai tera
phool sehre ke kahin jism pada hai tera
kitni bedardi se loota hai qiza ne chaman
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
gham se phat'ta hai kaleja mai agar sabr karun
kaun se dil se teri laash ko chadar mein bharun
baith kar uthne nahi deti zaeefi ki thakan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut ne dasht mein kya haal kiya hai tera
jism bhi ghodon se pamaal kiya hai tera
tujhko dekhegi to mar jayegi ek shab ki dulhan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya guzarti hai mere dil pa bataun kaise
lassh bikhri hui maqtal se uthaun kaise
bhai ka haath batane ko chale aao hassan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi ummeed bhi maa ki na bachi ay qasim
tere haathon mein hina kaisi rachi ay qasim
lag gaya haste huwe chand ko maqtal mein grahan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek qayamat dil e bewa pa guzar jayegi
tere marne ki khabar sunte hi mar jayegi
isne kya kya na kiye thay tere shadi ke jatan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne armaano bhare dil se sajaya tha tujhe
joda shadi ka samajh kar jo pinhaya tha tujhe
kya khabar thi wohi ban jayega maqtal mein kafan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe qasim pa thay akhtar yehi shabbir ke bain
kis tarha ghusl o kafan de tujhe ghurbat mein hussain
sharm aati hai mere laal paraya hai watan
tukde tukde hai badan
laashe qasim pe ye...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
